The winner is the v87 winner, the page's continuous pair, never a new one: a PAUSED record never fires (the P7 bound stands), a seg0 memory donates no anchor (P5), and a pair the page adopted FROM the record derives equal, never ahead, so an adopted pause can never be handed back through this door; clear() forgets the memory with the session.
